title: NPC 158006: teleport hunt
summary: Pursue a hidden Vex Thal opponent through two timed relocations.
overview: Pursue a hidden Vex Thal opponent through two timed relocations.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Expect fresh health bars after both relocations and organize the search immediately.

phases.label: First hunt
phases.description: Find the healed boss at the first random destination.

phases.label: Second hunt
phases.description: Find it again at the second random destination and finish before the new one-hour deadline.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 40% health in the first phase, the boss heals fully, clears hate and buffs, becomes protected for thirty seconds and moves to one of two locations.
The next 20% threshold repeats the transition using a second pair of possible destinations.
Each relocation starts a new one-hour deadline to find and kill the boss.
Missing the deadline removes the boss and starts its spawn timer.

notes: Approval R024. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.

Publication blocker: NPC 158006 has no display name or verified spawn-version mapping in the reviewed script. The numeric identity is preserved; resolve its database name and deployed version before publication.
